reviews.comment: Im glad I took his editing course. He's very professional and he treats students like colleagues or peers, never as inferiors. I could tell he really loves teaching. The class felt a bit busy at times but I cant really think of anything we did that felt unnecessary. Overall a great professor
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: One of the best professors in English for me. He's super respectful and approachable and his editing class was one of the greatest classes I've taken. For our final group project, we edited a client's document and he found clients for us, so we got some great authentic freelance editing experience. No exams but be ready for lots of homework.

10/10 a great professor! He's super laidback, genuinely cares about his students, and really knows what he does in the classroom. Attendance was mandatory but he's flexible with excused absences so long as you email him beforehand. His classes are practical, but be ready to write a lot. He was very responsive with emails too!
